sql:
SELECT 
  CAST(SUM((ol.UnitPrice - p.UnitCost) * ol.Quantity) AS decimal(14, 2)) * 100.0 / 
  SUM(ol.UnitPrice * ol.Quantity) AS GrossMarginPct
FROM sales.OrderLines AS ol
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId
WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'

SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(l.LineTotal) - SUM(l.Quantity * p.UnitCost)) / NULLIF(SUM(l.LineTotal), 0) AS GrossMarginPct
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = l.ProductId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'

SELECT w.WarehouseId, w.Name, 
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float) / COUNT(o.OrderId) AS ReturnRate
FROM inventory.Warehouses AS w
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.WarehouseId = w.WarehouseId
GROUP BY w.WarehouseId, w.Name

SELECT w.Name AS WarehouseName,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float) * 100.0 / 
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.Status IN ('Shipped', 'Delivered', 'Returned') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ReturnRate
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN inventory.Warehouses AS w ON w.WarehouseId = o.WarehouseId
GROUP BY w.Name

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerId) AS ActiveCustomers
FROM sales.Customers AS c
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND o.OrderDate >= DATEADD(month, -12, GETDATE())

SELECT CAST(SUM(l.LineTotal) AS decimal(14, 2)) AS Revenue
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2026-04-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-07-01'

SELECT CAST(SUM(l.LineTotal) AS decimal(14, 2)) AS Revenue
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2026-04-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-07-01'

SELECT 
  ((SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderDate >= '2026-07-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-08-01' THEN l.LineTotal ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderDate >= '2025-07-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2025-08-01' THEN l.LineTotal ELSE 0 END)) /
   SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderDate >= '2025-07-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2025-08-01' THEN l.LineTotal ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS RevenueChangePct
FROM sales.Orders AS o
JOIN sales.OrderLines AS l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')

WITH Revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(OrderDate) = 7 AND YEAR(OrderDate) = 2025 THEN LineTotal ELSE 0 END) AS Revenue2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(OrderDate) = 7 AND YEAR(OrderDate) = 2026 THEN LineTotal ELSE 0 END) AS Revenue2026
  FROM sales.Orders
  JOIN sales.OrderLines ON sales.OrderLines.OrderId = sales.Orders.OrderId
  WHERE Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
)
SELECT 
  (Revenue2026 - Revenue2025) * 100.0 / Revenue2025 AS GrowthPct
FROM Revenue
WHERE Revenue2025 <> 0

SELECT SUM(s.QuantityOnHand * p.ListPrice) AS TotalStockValue
FROM inventory.Stock AS s
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = s.ProductId

SELECT SUM(s.QuantityOnHand * p.ListPrice) AS TotalStockValueAtListPrice
FROM inventory.Stock AS s
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = s.ProductId

SELECT COUNT(*) AS OutOfStockProducts
FROM catalog.Products AS p
WHERE p.IsDiscontinued = 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM inventory.Stock AS s
    WHERE s.ProductId = p.ProductId
      AND s.QuantityOnHand = 0
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ProductId) AS OutOfStockProducts
FROM inventory.Stock AS s
JOIN catalog.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = s.ProductId
WHERE s.QuantityOnHand = 0 AND p.IsDiscontinued = 0

SELECT SUM(p.Amount) AS OutstandingAmount
FROM sales.Payments AS p
JOIN sales.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = p.OrderId
WHERE p.IsRefund = 0 AND o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')

FROM sales.Orders
WHERE OrderDate >= '2026-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2027-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrdersPlaced
FROM sales.Orders
WHERE OrderDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 1, 1) AND OrderDate < DATEADD(year, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 1, 1))

SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(day, o.OrderDate, o.ShippedDate)) AS AverageDaysToShip
FROM sales.Orders AS o
WHERE o.ShippedDate IS NOT NULL

SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(hour, o.OrderDate, o.ShippedDate)) AS AverageShippingTime
FROM sales.Orders AS o
WHERE o.ShippedDate IS NOT NULL
